reviews.summary: No current, directly relevant exploit, outage, delisting/maintenance notice, regulatory action, or confirmed near-term CAP unlock was found. CAP identity matches Cap’s Bitvavo-listed token; supply dilution remains a structural—not newly triggered—risk.

facts.fact: Cap’s official Q2 update confirms CAP was listed on Bitvavo, supporting identification of CAP-EUR as Cap’s token. ([cap.app](https://www.cap.app/blog/investor-update-q2-2026?utm_source=openai))

Current trackers report 1.56B CAP circulating out of a 10B maximum supply; this is a standing dilution consideration, but no specific imminent unlock was verified in the audit window. ([coinmarketcap.com](https://coinmarketcap.com/currencies/cap-app/?utm_source=openai))

The latest official project update located was published July 16, 2026; it reported Q2 TVL and deposits declined quarter-over-quarter, but did not disclose a security incident or token-market disruption. ([cap.app](https://www.cap.app/blog/investor-update-q2-2026?utm_source=openai))
